commits.author: gravhoek-rw
lines: Added convex hull collider support to the GLB importer utility.
Imported new versions of CoreCommandA, CoreStructuralA, CoreFairingA.

commits.author: JoshRW
lines: Improve error logging for unnamed / invalid TextureAssets when creating a SimpleVkTexture.

commits.author: gravhoek-rw
lines: Fixed the thruster cache not recomputing when propellant tanks had their usage flags toggled off/on. This presented as thrusters not working even once new propellant was released for their use.

commits.author: gravhoek-rw
lines: Fixed incorrect RSS for gimbal commands that are constrained to a circle (no part actually uses this currently).

commits.author: lghassen
lines: Fix crash on startup on AMD GPUs, the bindless texture library clamps the array size to the device update-after-bind limit. On AMD this is uint.MaxValue but the binding is declared as int, which reads back as -1
Reduce the planet frustum culling push constant size to be 128 bytes by reusing an unused float, matching the min vulkan spec guarantee
Fix volumetric particles showing white artifacts on AMD GPUs, use the same reimplemented tanh function already used in the ocean shader

commits.author: MattCaradusRW
lines: Added Jobs tab to Profiler. Individual Job Runners can now be viewed in the profiler, you can use Begin/End Calls to profile specific portions of code for runtime and allocations.
Updated KSA to latest Brutal.Concurrency package.

commits.author: JPLRepoRocketWerkz
lines: Added baseline tests for burn planning and timing ahead of finite burns.
Moved the flight computer ignition timing into FlightComputer.TimeBurn so tests can check it.

commits.author: gravhoek-rw
lines: Changed the TVC controller from LQR to LQI. This introduces an integral term which can remove steady-state error that the LQR (effectively a PD controller) cannot.
Added required methods to double3x3 due to the increased dimensionality of the plant model and controller.
Added integral values to the flight computer debug menu.

commits.author: gravhoek-rw
lines: Removed the 10 Hz limit on TVC attitude control. Instead, we geometrically increase the allowable timestep based on the current attitude errors and re-solve TVC gains for that new timestep. This allows continuous stable control of attitude even at extreme interstellar levels of time compression and over burns lasting months.
Removed attitude control timestep diagnostics and associated fields.

commits.author: gravhoek-rw
lines: Control the growth of the TVC controller quantity authority * dt^2 rather than dt itself.

commits.author: gravhoek-rw
lines: Generate feedforward gains for the same control rate as the feedback gains.
